dashboard.label: Better Map - Site Availability
dashboard.description: Global site availability dashboard. Pulsing site markers (color by status), glow-on-dark cinematic basemap, top-row KPIs (total sites, healthy %, warning %, critical count, hottest region), region/category/status filter dropdowns, top-N tables for highest-load and most-critical regions, and a regional load-distribution chart. Powered by the bundled `better_map_sample_sites.csv` lookup.
